slug: 娇软妹宝随军后禁欲军官沦陷了

第(1/3)页

我也没得罪她啊

正当苏清荔为她的态度感到莫名其妙时，住在右侧的邻居王桂花端着衣服走了过来。

“别理她，这人有毛病。”她笑着拉住苏清荔，“你是傅营妹妹苏清荔吧？前两天就听说你要过来，今天总算见到本人了。”

“你是......”

见苏清荔有些疑惑看着自己，王桂花主动介绍说，“我丈夫是刘铁军，跟你哥同级，他俩关系很要好，你要不嫌弃，也跟着叫我一声嫂子。”

“嫂子，你进来吧。”见她手里还拿着东西，苏清荔忙把人迎了进来。

“这是我从老家带的果脯，你尝尝。”

王桂花倒也没跟她客气。

见她捏了几颗果脯，又喝了杯水，苏清荔这才问，“嫂子，刚那人是谁啊？”

王桂花进来，原本就是为了说这事，当即放下手里瓷缸，说，“她啊，叫张翠，丈夫陈立业原本是林大勇手下的副官，这不，前段时间林大勇被调走了，他就想要让老婆回老家，把两个孩子也带过来随军，哪成想，部队这次分的房子只有两间卧室，他们夫妻住一间，剩下那一间不够住，只能挤挤。”

所以，张翠看不惯她，是觉得自己抢了他们的房子？

认识到这点，苏清荔有些好笑。

先不说这间房子本来就是傅谨严立功得来的，再说就算没有她，等傅谨严结婚的时候，照样也会收回去。

跟她有什么关系？

“这也太不讲理了。”苏清荔有些无语。

“谁说不是呢？”王桂花显然也看透这点，安慰苏清荔，“你住这里是应该的，别把外面的风言风语放在心上。”

“嫂子，谢谢你告诉我这些。”要不是王桂花主动来说，她就真被蒙在鼓里了。

“嗨，你跟嫂子客气什么？”虽只见过一面，王桂花却很喜欢苏清荔，“没事的时候，多往嫂子家里坐坐。”

苏清荔送她到门外时，隔壁张翠正摔摔打打的朝丈夫抱怨。

“你说说你，待在部队那么久，就没想着多给自己争取争取？”

“人傅谨严跟你是同级，怎么人妹妹一来，就能住那么大院子，咱家大丫十来岁了，却还得跟弟弟挤在一起，连换衣服的地方都没有？”

“我能怎么办？”陈立业表情有些烦躁，“当初傅谨严为了完成部队给的任务，一条腿都被炸瘸了，上面也是怕他以后落下残疾影响婚姻，这才特批一间大院子。”

“那也不能太厚此薄彼吧！”张翠想想还是觉得委屈，“这些年你不也兢兢业业的跟着林大勇吗？眼看他走了，也熬出头了，凭啥就因为那丫头过来，就挤在这里？我是咽不下这口气。”

在张翠心里，傅谨严对住哪里压根就不在意。

要是他妹妹没来，傅谨严肯定会看在他们一家四口的面子上，把房子让出来。

I didn't offend her either.

Just when Su Qingli was puzzled by her attitude, her neighbor Wang Guihua, who lived on the right, came over carrying clothes.

"Ignore her, there is something wrong with this person." She smiled and pulled Su Qingli, "Are you Fu Ying's sister Su Qingli? I heard you were coming two days ago, and I finally saw you today."

"You are..."

Seeing Su Qingli looking at her with some confusion, Wang Guihua took the initiative to introduce her, "My husband is Liu Tiejun. He is at the same level as your brother. They have a very close relationship. If you don't mind, you can also call me sister-in-law."

"Sister-in-law, come in." Seeing that she was still holding something in her hand, Su Qingli hurriedly welcomed the person in.

"This is the preserved fruit I brought from my hometown. You can try it."

Wang Guihua was not polite to her either.

Seeing her squeeze a few preserved fruits and drink a glass of water, Su Qingli asked, "Sister-in-law, who was that person just now?"

Wang Guihua came in just to talk about this. She immediately put down the porcelain jar in her hand and said, "Her name is Zhang Cui. Her husband Chen Liye was originally an adjutant under Lin Dayong. No, Lin Dayong was transferred away some time ago. He wanted his wife to return to his hometown and bring his two children with him to join the army. Who would have thought that the house allocated by the army this time only has two bedrooms. The couple lives in one, and the remaining one is not enough, so they have to squeeze in."

So, Zhang Cui couldn't stand her, because he thought he had robbed their house?

Realizing this, Su Qingli was a little funny.

Not to mention that this house was originally obtained by Fu Jinyan's meritorious service, and even without her, Fu Jinyan would still take it back when he gets married.

What does it have to do with her?

"This is too unreasonable." Su Qingli was speechless.

"Who says it's not?" Wang Guihua obviously saw through this and comforted Su Qingli, "You deserve to live here. Don't take the gossip outside to heart."

"Sister-in-law, thank you for telling me this." If Wang Guihua hadn't taken the initiative to say it, she would have been kept in the dark.

"Hey, why are you being polite to your sister-in-law?" Although they have only met once, Wang Guihua likes Su Qingli very much. "When you have nothing to do, go to your sister-in-law's house to sit there more often."

When Su Qingli walked her outside, Zhang Cui next door was beating and complaining to her husband.

"Tell me, you have been in the army for so long and you never thought about fighting for yourself?"

"Fu Jingyan is at the same level as you. How come my sister can live in such a big yard when my sister comes here? Our eldest daughter is over ten years old, but she still has to squeeze in with her younger brother without even a place to change clothes?"

"What can I do?" Chen Liye looked a little irritated. "In order to complete the task assigned by the army, one of Fu Jinyan's legs was blown away. The superiors were also worried that his disability would affect his marriage in the future, so they specially approved a large courtyard."

"Then you can't be too unfair to one!" Zhang Cui still felt aggrieved after thinking about it, "Didn't you follow Lin Dayong conscientiously all these years? Seeing that he is gone and you have made it, why are you crowded here just because that girl came over? I can't swallow this breath."

In Zhang Cui's heart, Fu Jingyan didn't care where he lived.

If his sister had not come, Fu Jinyan would definitely give up the house for the sake of their family of four.
